text:
Asha: Quick sync — launching a small "preview signal funnel" to triage pilot enrollments and prioritize outreach. Goal: 1) surface high-impact accounts, 2) push a lightweight survey to capture urgency & security readiness, 3) schedule 15-min onboarding slots. Draft survey (editable): https://redwood.ai/surveys/preview-signal-v1. Thoughts?

Benji: Love this. Propose a simple scoring heuristic: API calls (30d), product-fit tag, security checklist ready. Example: `score = min(10, floor(log10(api_calls+1))) + security_ready*5 + alpha_fit*3`. Can surface top N for 1:1 invites.

Luca: I can run the pull — SQL snippet to get us started: `SELECT account_id, company_name, sum(api_calls) as calls, tags, security_ready FROM accounts WHERE updated_at > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY account_id, company_name, tags, security_ready ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 500;` Will run and drop CSV into the Coda doc.

Maya: I'll own a 1-page "first-15" enablement playbook + templated calendar invite. Also can host a weekly 15-min office hour (Thurs 10am PT) for folks who prefer group onboarding. Should we include a short checklist in the survey for KMS/HSM needs?

Oliver_ops: Heads-up on capacity: our enablement team can handle ~10 dedicated 15-min sessions/week next two weeks (some folks OOO). If we go beyond that we should default to the group office hour. @asha_cs can you prioritize high-score accounts?

Benji: Yes, add an open feedback field for "primary concern" (model quality, latency, cost, security). Pipe responses into Coda so Product/ML can pick up trends. Suggest webhooks -> https://coda.io/d/preview-signal for automated routing.

deploybot: survey "preview-signal-v1" created by asha_cs at 2024-11-05 14:32 UTC — link: https://redwood.ai/surveys/preview-signal-v1

Asha: Action items — :one: @luca_prod run query and drop CSV into Coda by EOD today; :two: @maya_se publish the 1-pager + invite template by tomorrow AM; :three: @benji_cs add scoring column + setup simple webhook to Coda for responses; :four: @oliver_ops confirm capacity or propose overflow plan by EOD. I'll own outreach and the first wave of invites.

Benji: Acknowledged :thumbsup:

Maya: Got it — will post draft in #customer-success-docs and ping this thread when ready.

luca_prod: Ran query and dropped CSV into Coda (sheet: Accounts > Preview Signal). Link: https://coda.io/d/preview-signal#Accounts. Top 30 accounts flagged with preliminary scores.

Oliver_ops: Confirmed capacity: 10/week. Recommend batching invites Tue morning to smooth load. If we hit >10/wk, we'll switch to group office hour and triage for followups.

Asha: Perfect — I'll begin outreach tomorrow using the scoring to prioritize. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
